# Effective Claude Code Usage

This is the well-known discovery copy for agentic assistants.

Canonical slides: https://www.indrapatil.com/effective-claude-code-usage/
Root llms.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/effective-claude-code-usage/llms.txt
Root llms-full.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/effective-claude-code-usage/llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/effective-claude-code-usage/

Summary: A Quarto RevealJS presentation on using Claude Code effectively as a CLI agent for software engineering. The deck covers tool use, permission modes, sandboxing, skills (using and writing them), workflows, context management, CLAUDE.md, auto memory, subagents, background agents, planning mode, hooks, prompting, MCP, Git worktrees, and non-interactive automation with `claude -p` in scripts and CI.
